sources.name: Mustakbil
sources.notes: Mustakbil's Terms of Service explicitly prohibit copying, scraping, framing, reverse engineering, creating candidate/employer databases, and machine learning training without express authorization.

sources.name: Rozee.pk
sources.notes: Automated access to robots.txt returns HTTP 403 Forbidden via WAF/anti-bot protection. Platform terms restrict automated data harvesting and candidate information extraction. Requires explicit written permission or official API.

sources.name: Open Data Pakistan - Job Market
sources.notes: Public research dataset released under Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Dataset is static historical data. Live web scraping of platform views is restricted by robots.txt (Disallow /dataset/*/resource/*/view/ with Crawl-delay 10).
